sentence: Ms. Tanaka was ___ to the position of regional director last week.
The new software is ___ easier to use than the previous version.
explanation: 'Much' intensifies a comparative; 'very', 'so' and 'too' do not.

sentence: Please keep your receipt as ___ of purchase.
explanation: 'Proof of purchase' is a fixed expression (noun needed after 'as').

sentence: Mr. Garcia asked ___ the conference room had been reserved.
The factory will remain closed ___ the renovation is finished.
explanation: 'Until' is followed by a clause and marks the end of a period.

sentence: All visitors are required to wear a ___ badge at all times.
explanation: An adjective is needed before the noun 'badge'.

sentence: Our supplier delivers orders ___ within three business days.
explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'delivers'.

sentence: The committee will ___ the proposal before making a final decision.
explanation: After the modal 'will', the base form of the verb is used.
